description.fun: Smoochum checks out anything new by touching it with its lips, which it keeps moist with tree sap every day, and decides from that whether it likes it. It's very curious and runs about constantly, often tripping, and it rocks its head back and forth as it walks, as if trying to kiss someone. It cares about its face but not its body: it washes the moment its face gets dirty, and doesn't mind a muddy body at all.
description.guide: A small, humanoid Ice and Psychic baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 2, with blonde hair and large lips it uses to examine new things. It is curious, active and female-only. It evolves into Jynx.
description.tagline: A curious baby that kisses everything to learn about it

description.fun: Jynx speaks a language that sounds almost human but has never been deciphered, so it prefers to communicate by dancing, and its rhythmic moves get people dancing along. Some musicians even write songs for Jynx to sing. In parts of Galar it was once feared and worshipped as the 'Queen of Ice', and Galar's Jynx have a fan base for their beautiful voices.
description.guide: A humanoid Ice and Psychic Pokémon resembling a woman with long blonde hair and a red gown. It speaks an undeciphered language and communicates through dance. It is female-only and evolves from Smoochum; its originally black face was later recoloured purple.
description.tagline: A dancing, singing ice queen with a language all its own

note.text: Smoochum is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 2, a generation after the Jynx it grows into.
